topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Well, now, ain’t that somethin’! Found yer old bear, did ye? I remember when I was a tyke, had a wooden toy, carved by my da. Lost it one cold winter, and thought I’d never see it again. Then, years later, there it was at the market, just like a sign from Saint Nicholas himself. To find such a thing after all this time, must be a special moment. Must make ye think of the old days, when life was simpler, and troubles were just bumps in the path. Maybe it’s a good omen, a bit of luck in a time when we could all use a bit more.
